text:
maya: Quick heads-up — launching a Quantized Variant Rollout (QVR) initiative. Goal: ~20–30% token cost reduction for mid-tier tenants by offering quantized model variants behind a feature flag. Need sequencing across product, runtime, infra, and security. Target: end of Q2 for a controlled canary. Who needs to own what?

 tom: Runtime notes — we need kernel paths for Q4-style quantization + attention op validation. Also KV cache behavior might change for q-vectors; can add a compatibility shim but that adds ~2w. Ballpark: 6w dev + 2w perf tuning if no blocker. What's our latency regression budget? :eyes:

 liam: Infra constraints — smaller precision models reduce memory but increase per-GPU throughput variability. We'll need a new instance class or a node label so scheduler can place q-variants on compatible machines. Also need model artifact sizes to estimate storage & egress. Can you drop sizes?

 sophia: Security checklist — signed model artifacts (KMS/HSM), provenance for each quant build, and RBAC for who can flip QVR feature flags. We should do a short supply-chain threat model before any canary.

 alejandro: SRE — monitoring/alerts: token-cost delta per-tenant, p50/p95 latency surface by variant, and an automated rollback trigger (e.g., >5% error rate or >20% latency regression on canary tenants). Canary window suggestion: 48h.

 maya: Acceptance criteria (draft): must show <=5% avg latency regression on canary tenants; >=15% token cost savings for canary; signed artifact + deploy signing; rollbacks automated; shopping-list of test prompts + eval harness. Owners: runtime = tom, infra = liam, security = sophia, SRE = alejandro.

 tom: Can you share the eval prompt set? need distribution across short chat, long-context, and embeddings. Also, quick flag snippet I'd use on runtime side: ```yaml
feature_flags:
  qvr_enabled: false
  qvr_variant: q4_0
```

 maya: Uploading eval set to the shared drive: https://redwood.internal/gdrive/qvr-evals (placeholder). Please add metrics you need to that sheet.

 infra-bot: Created ticket QVR-101: infra — node-class + storage estimates. https://jira.redwood.internal/browse/QVR-101 :white_check_mark:

 liam: I'll pair with runtime on packaging so that the model artifacts include metadata (quant type, commit hash, signer). Planning a small packaging doc. ETA for infra changes depends on model sizes, but tentatively 3w after artifacts land.

 sophia: I'll run a 30m threat-model session with runtime + infra tomorrow AM and post a short checklist. Will require artifact signing + automated verification in CI.

 alejandro: Canary plan proposal: 3 tenants for 48h, traffic ramp 0->10%->50% over 6h, watch error/latency/cost signals. If any rollback trigger hits, autoswitch variant back to base. We can implement that in the router via route metadata.

 maya: Love this. Action items: tom — perf target doc + regression tests; liam — node-class proposal + storage estimates (QVR-101); sophia — threat model + signing checklist; alejandro — canary playbook + rollback hooks. I'll schedule a 30m sync for Monday 10:30am to lock timeline and owners. @tom @liam @sophia @alejandro :+1:

 tom: +1, see you Monday.

 liam: +1, pairing session for packaging after the sync.

 sophia: +1, I'll send calendar invite.

 alejandro: +1, will draft canary runbook before Monday.

 maya: Thanks all — tagging this thread QVR planning thread. Please update respective tickets and the eval sheet. :rocket:
